result.result:
I added a guard that stops the network picking a phase with no vehicles while another phase has one. On the dev episodes it brings mean TTS from 44.51 to 44.26, a small gain of about 0.5%.

**What I changed and why:** in nearly empty states the original keeps its current green even when the only waiting car faces red. It does this in 296 of my test states with one to three cars on a single lane. In the final drain, with no new arrivals, that car can wait until the 30-minute cap. I built one gate per phase: four first-layer units that fire when the phase's lanes are empty, each relayed through a second-layer unit to lower that phase's score by 30. These units were the least important ones. Stuck cases drop to 0; about 2% of other decisions shift as a side effect.

**Parameters changed:** 112 of 7428.

**Simulator calls:** 4 of 5 used.

| Call | Edit | Params | Dev mean TTS |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Symmetry repair only | 192 | 44.49, one car left at the drain cap |
| 2 | Guard only (delivered) | 112 | 44.26 |
| 3 | Repair + guard | 303 | 44.32 |
| 4 | Guard, extra weights cut | 352 | 44.32 |

All three guarded versions beat the original, mostly in the high scenario. The symmetry repair added nothing, so I left it out.

**Final dev TTS:** 44.26 (low 34.41, nominal 44.53, high 53.85).

**Test predictions:** low 34.4, nominal 44.5, high 54.0.

Everything is in `/home/traffic-ntua/wsp_v3_agent_runs/patch/net1_b5/work/`; `NOTES.md` has the details.
